question: Find the top 5 directors who have directed the most movies in the 'Action' genre, along with the count of such movies.
gql: MATCH (d:DIRECTOR)<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE) WHERE g.name = 'Action' RETURN d, COUNT(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Retrieve the top 10 actors who have acted in the most movies that are similar to 'Movie Title 1' with a similarity score greater than 0.8. Return the actor names and the count of such movies.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(m1:MOVIE) WHERE m1.title = 'Movie Title 1' AND s.similarity_score > 0.8 RETURN a.name, COUNT(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: Find all users who rated movies with a rating value greater than 4 and also tagged at least one movie.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(r:RATING) WHERE r.rating_value > 4 RETURN u NEXT MATCH (u:USER)-[:ASSIGNS]->(t:TAG) RETURN DISTINCT u

question: Find pairs of similar movies (with a similarity score greater than 0.8) and return their titles along with the similarity score.
gql: MATCH (m1:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(m2:MOVIE) WHERE s.similarity_score > 0.8 RETURN m1.title, m2.title, s.similarity_score

question: Calculate the average age of users who have rated movies belonging to the 'Action' genre.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(:RATING)-[:RATES]->(m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE {name: 'Action'}) RETURN AVG(u.age) AS average_age

question: Find the average rating value given by users aged between 25 and 35 for movies released after 2010.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(r:RATING)<-[:RATES]-(m:MOVIE) WHERE u.age >= 25 AND u.age <= 35 AND m.release_date > date('2010-12-31') RETURN AVG(r.rating_value) AS average_rating

question: List the titles of all movies directed by directors who have directed at least 5 movies, along with the director's name and the count of movies they directed.
gql: MATCH (m:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d:DIRECTOR) RETURN d, COUNT(m) AS movie_count NEXT MATCH (m2:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d) RETURN d.name AS director_name, m2.title AS movie_title, movie_count

question: Identify actors who have acted in at least 3 movies that are similar to each other with a similarity score above 0.8, and list their names along with the movie titles.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[ai:ACTED_IN]->(m1:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(m2:MOVIE) WHERE s.similarity_score > 0.8 RETURN a, m1, m2, COUNT(s) AS sim_count NEXT RETURN DISTINCT a.name, m1.title, m2.title

question: Find the average age of users who have rated movies with a rating value greater than 4.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)<-[:RATES]-(r:RATING {rating_value: 5}) RETURN AVG(u.age) AS average_age

question: List all users who have rated movies with a rating value of 5 and also tagged any movie, showing their user IDs and occupations.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(r:RATING{rating_value:5}) RETURN u NEXT MATCH (u)-[:ASSIGNS]->(t:TAG) RETURN DISTINCT u.USER_id, u.occupation

question: Retrieve the names of actors who acted in movies released after 2010 and the titles of those movies.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[ai:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE) WHERE m.release_date > date('2010-12-31') RETURN a.name, m.title

question: Count the number of movies in each genre and return the genre name along with the count, sorted by the count in descending order.
gql: MATCH (g:GENRE)<-[:BELONGS_TO]-(m:MOVIE) RETURN g.name, COUNT(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC

question: Find pairs of similar movies (based on SIMILAR_TO edges) where both movies belong to the 'Comedy' genre and display their similarity scores.
gql: MATCH (m1:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(m2:MOVIE), (m1)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g1:GENRE {name: 'Comedy'}), (m2)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g2:GENRE {name: 'Comedy'}) RETURN m1.title, m2.title, s.similarity_score

question: List the titles of movies released after January 1, 2000, along with their genres.
gql: MATCH (m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE) WHERE m.release_date > date('2000-01-01') RETURN m.title, g.name

question: Count how many movies each director has directed and return the director's name along with the count.
gql: MATCH (d:DIRECTOR)<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(m:MOVIE) RETURN d.name, COUNT(m) AS movie_count

question: Identify actors who have acted in more than 5 movies and list their names along with the number of movies they've acted in.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE) RETURN a, COUNT(m) AS num_movies NEXT RETURN a.name, num_movies

question: Find the top 10 most similar movie pairs based on similarity score, including their titles and the similarity score.
gql: MATCH (m1:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(m2:MOVIE) RETURN m1.title, m2.title, s.similarity_score ORDER BY s.similarity_score DESC LIMIT 10

question: Find the average age of users who have rated movies with a rating value greater than 3.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)<-[:RATES]-(r:RATING) WHERE r.rating_value > 3 RETURN AVG(u.age) AS average_age

question: Retrieve the names of actors who acted in movies released after January 1, 2000, along with the character names they played.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[ai:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE) WHERE m.release_date > date('2000-01-01') RETURN a.name, ai.character_name

question: Retrieve the top 5 most similar movies to 'Movie Title 1' based on similarity score, including their titles and similarity scores.
gql: MATCH (m1:MOVIE {title: "Movie Title 1"})-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(m2:MOVIE) RETURN m2.title, s.similarity_score ORDER BY s.similarity_score DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find genres that have at least one movie released before the year 2000 and count how many such movies exist per genre.
gql: MATCH (g:GENRE)<-[:BELONGS_TO]-(m:MOVIE) WHERE m.release_date < date('2000-01-01') RETURN g.name, COUNT(m) AS movie_count

question: Find the average rating value for the movie with ID 10.
gql: MATCH (m:MOVIE)<-[:RATES]-(r:RATING) WHERE m.MOVIE_id = 10 RETURN avg(r.rating_value) AS average_rating

question: Find actors who have acted in movies similar to 'Movie Title 1' (based on SIMILAR_TO relationship) and return the actor names along with the titles of those similar movies.
gql: MATCH (m1:MOVIE {title: 'Movie Title 1'})-[:SIMILAR_TO]->(m2:MOVIE)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:ACTOR) RETURN a.name, m2.title

question: Retrieve the names of directors who have directed movies that are similar to at least two other movies with a similarity score greater than 0.75.
gql: MATCH (d:DIRECTOR)<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(m1:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(m2:MOVIE) WHERE s.similarity_score > 0.75 RETURN d, COUNT(s) AS similar_count NEXT RETURN DISTINCT d.name

question: List the top 5 production companies that have produced the highest number of movies in the 'Sci-Fi' genre, along with the count of such movies.
gql: MATCH (pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE) WHERE g.name = 'Sci-Fi' RETURN pc.name, COUNT(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find the top 10 users who have assigned the most tags to movies, along with the count of tags they've assigned.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:ASSIGNS]->(t:TAG) RETURN u, COUNT(t) AS tag_count ORDER BY tag_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: Find the top 5 actors who have acted in movies with the highest average similarity scores, along with their names and the average similarity score.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(:MOVIE) RETURN a.name, AVG(s.similarity_score) AS avg_similarity ORDER BY avg_similarity DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find the top 3 users who have assigned the most tags to movies, along with the count of tags they've assigned and their user IDs.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:ASSIGNS]->(t:TAG) RETURN u, COUNT(t) AS tag_count NEXT RETURN u.USER_id, tag_count ORDER BY tag_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: List all movies that were produced by the same production company as 'Movie Title 1' and also belong to the 'Action' genre.
gql: MATCH (m1:MOVIE {title: 'Movie Title 1'})-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m2:MOVIE), (m2)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE {name: 'Action'}) RETURN DISTINCT m2.title

question: List all production companies that have produced movies in the 'Action' genre, along with the count of such movies.
gql: MATCH (pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE {name: 'Action'}) RETURN pc.name, COUNT(m) AS action_movie_count

question: List the top 5 production companies by the total number of movies they have produced, including the company name and the count of movies.
gql: MATCH (pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:MOVIE) RETURN pc.name AS company_name, COUNT(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find users who have rated more than 10 movies and tagged at least 5 movies, displaying their user IDs along with the counts of ratings and tags.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(r:RATING) RETURN u, COUNT(r) AS rating_count NEXT MATCH (u)-[:ASSIGNS]->(t:TAG) RETURN u, rating_count, COUNT(t) AS tag_count NEXT RETURN u.USER_id, rating_count, tag_count

question: Identify movies that are similar to at least two other movies with a similarity score greater than 0.8, returning the movie titles and the count of such similarities.
gql: MATCH (m:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(other:MOVIE) WHERE s.similarity_score > 0.8 RETURN m, COUNT(other) AS similar_count NEXT RETURN m.title, similar_count

gql: MATCH (m:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d:DIRECTOR)<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(horror_movie:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE {name: 'Horror'}) WHERE m.release_date >= date('2000-01-01') AND m.release_date <= date('2000-12-31') RETURN DISTINCT m.title

question: Find the average age of users who have rated movies produced by 'Production Company A' and sort the results by the average age in descending order.
gql: MATCH (pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY {name: 'Production Company A'})<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:MOVIE)<-[:RATES]-(r:RATING)<-[:RATES]-(u:USER) RETURN avg(u.age) AS average_age ORDER BY average_age DESC

question: For each actor, calculate the average similarity score of movies they have acted in compared to 'Movie Title 1'. Only include actors whose average similarity score is greater than 0.5.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(m1:MOVIE{title:'Movie Title 1'}) RETURN a, AVG(s.similarity_score) AS avg_similarity NEXT RETURN a.name, avg_similarity

question: Find all production companies that produced movies in which 'Actor 229' acted, and return the company names along with the count of such movies per company.

question: List all production companies that have produced movies in the 'Sci-Fi' genre, along with the count of such movies per company.

question: Identify users who have rated at least 3 movies with a perfect score (rating value of 5) and have also tagged at least one movie, returning their user ID, occupation, and the count of distinct tags they've assigned.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(r:RATING{rating_value:5}) RETURN u, COUNT(r) AS rating_count NEXT MATCH (u)-[:ASSIGNS]->(t:TAG) RETURN u, COUNT(t) AS tag_count NEXT RETURN u.USER_id, u.occupation, tag_count

question: What are the names of directors who have never directed a movie in the 'Horror' genre?

question: Find actors who have acted in at least 5 movies and return their names along with the count of distinct genres of those movies.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE) RETURN a, COUNT(g) AS genre_count, COUNT(m) AS movie_count NEXT RETURN a.name, genre_count

question: What is the average rating value given by users aged between 25 and 35 for movies released after January 1, 2000?
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(r:RATING)<-[:RATES]-(m:MOVIE) WHERE u.age >= 25 AND u.age <= 35 AND m.release_date > date('2000-01-01') RETURN AVG(r.rating_value) AS average_rating

question: Find the top 5 most similar movies to 'Movie Title 129' with a similarity score greater than 0.9, and return their titles along with the similarity scores.
gql: MATCH (m:MOVIE {title: 'Movie Title 129'})-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(similar_movies:MOVIE) WHERE s.similarity_score > 0.9 RETURN similar_movies.title, s.similarity_score ORDER BY s.similarity_score DESC LIMIT 5

question: List the titles of movies that were produced by 'United Pictures' and belong to the 'Action' genre, along with their release dates.
gql: MATCH (m:MOVIE)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY {name: 'United Pictures'}), (m)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE {name: 'Action'}) RETURN m.title, m.release_date

question: Retrieve the names of actors who have acted in movies with a similarity score greater than 0.8 to at least three other movies, along with the count of such high-similarity connections.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(m2:MOVIE) WHERE s.similarity_score > 0.8 RETURN a, COUNT(s) AS high_sim_count NEXT RETURN a.name, high_sim_count

question: Find pairs of movies that share at least two common actors and return their titles along with the count of common actors.
gql: MATCH (m1:MOVIE)<-[ai1:ACTED_IN]-(a:ACTOR)-[ai2:ACTED_IN]->(m2:MOVIE) WHERE m1 <> m2 RETURN m1, m2, COUNT(a) AS common_actors NEXT RETURN m1.title, m2.title, common_actors

question: List all actors who have acted in at least three movies directed by the same director, including the director's name and the count of movies.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[ai:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d:DIRECTOR) RETURN a, d, COUNT(m) AS movie_count NEXT RETURN a.name, d.name, movie_count

question: Find the top 10 actors who have acted in the most movies that belong to the 'Drama' genre, including their names and the count of such movies.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[ai:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE {name: 'Drama'}) RETURN a.name AS actor_name, COUNT(m) AS drama_movie_count ORDER BY drama_movie_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: Retrieve the titles and release dates of movies that were directed by directors who have directed at least two movies in the 'Comedy' genre.
gql: MATCH (m:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d:DIRECTOR)<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(comedy_movie:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE{name:'Comedy'}) RETURN d, COUNT(comedy_movie) AS comedy_count NEXT MATCH (d)<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(m:MOVIE) RETURN DISTINCT m.title, m.release_date

question: Retrieve the names of directors who have directed movies in both 'Action' and 'Romance' genres, along with the titles of those movies.
gql: MATCH (d:DIRECTOR)<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(m1:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g1:GENRE {name: 'Action'}), (d)<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(m2:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g2:GENRE {name: 'Romance'}) RETURN d.name, m1.title, m2.title

question: List the titles of movies that were produced by 'United Pictures' and belong to at least three different genres.
gql: MATCH (m:MOVIE)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY{name:'United Pictures'}) RETURN m, COUNT(g) AS genre_count NEXT RETURN m.title

question: List the titles of movies that were produced by the same company that produced 'Movie Title 1', excluding 'Movie Title 1' itself, and sort them alphabetically.
gql: MATCH (m1:MOVIE {title: 'Movie Title 1'})-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m2:MOVIE) WHERE m1 <> m2 RETURN m2.title ORDER BY m2.title

question: Identify the top 10 most frequently used tags across all movies, including the tag text and the number of times each tag was used, sorted by usage frequency in descending order.
gql: MATCH (:USER)-[:ASSIGNS]->(t:TAG) RETURN t.tag_text, COUNT(*) AS usage_count ORDER BY usage_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: Identify production companies that have produced movies directed by directors who have directed at least 5 movies, along with the company name and the count of such movies.
gql: MATCH (pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d:DIRECTOR) RETURN d, COUNT(m) AS directed_movies NEXT MATCH (pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d) RETURN pc.name, COUNT(m) AS movie_count

question: Identify actors who have acted in movies produced by at least three different production companies and return their names along with the count of distinct production companies.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[ai:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[pb:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY) RETURN a, COUNT(pc) AS distinct_production_companies NEXT RETURN a.name, distinct_production_companies

question: Find users who have rated movies with an average rating value greater than 4 and have also assigned at least one tag, returning their user IDs and the average rating value.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(r:RATING) RETURN u, AVG(r.rating_value) AS avg_rating NEXT MATCH (u)-[:ASSIGNS]->(t:TAG) RETURN u, avg_rating, COUNT(t) AS tag_count NEXT RETURN u.USER_id, avg_rating

question: Find the top 5 production companies whose movies have the highest average similarity scores with other movies, and return the company names and average similarity scores.
gql: MATCH (pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m1:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(m2:MOVIE) RETURN pc, AVG(s.similarity_score) AS avg_similarity NEXT RETURN pc.name, avg_similarity ORDER BY avg_similarity DESC LIMIT 5

question: Identify actors who have acted in movies directed by 'Director 48' and also in movies produced by 'Silver Pictures'. Return the actor names and the count of distinct movies they have acted in under these conditions.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m1:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d:DIRECTOR {name: 'Director 48'}), (a)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m2:MOVIE)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY {name: 'Silver Pictures'}) RETURN a.name, COUNT(DISTINCT m1) + COUNT(DISTINCT m2) AS total_movies

question: List all genres that have at least one movie with a similarity score greater than 0.9 to another movie. Return the genre names and the count of such high-similarity connections.
gql: MATCH (g:GENRE)<-[:BELONGS_TO]-(m1:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(m2:MOVIE) WHERE s.similarity_score > 0.9 RETURN g, COUNT(s) AS high_similarity_count NEXT RETURN g.name, high_similarity_count

question: List all production companies that have produced movies in at least three different genres, including the count of distinct genres and the total number of movies produced by each company.
gql: MATCH (pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE) RETURN pc, COUNT(g) AS genre_count, COUNT(m) AS movie_count NEXT RETURN pc.name, genre_count, movie_count

question: List the top 10 most collaborative actors (those who have appeared in the highest number of movies with other actors), showing their names and the count of unique actor collaborations.
gql: MATCH (a1:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a2:ACTOR) WHERE a1 <> a2 RETURN a1.name, COUNT(DISTINCT a2) AS collaboration_count ORDER BY collaboration_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: Find production companies that have produced movies released after 2000 and calculate the total number of such movies per company, sorted in descending order of the count.
gql: MATCH (pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:MOVIE) WHERE m.release_date > date('2000-12-31') RETURN pc.name, COUNT(m) AS post_2000_movies ORDER BY post_2000_movies DESC

question: Find the production companies that have produced movies featuring actors who have acted in at least 3 different genres, and return the company names along with the number of such versatile actors.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE) RETURN a, COUNT(g) AS genre_count NEXT MATCH (a)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m2:MOVIE)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY) RETURN pc.name, COUNT(a) AS versatile_actor_count

question: Count the number of distinct movies rated by the user with ID 1.

question: Find all users aged 40 and return their information, with a maximum of 10 records.

question: Find the average age of users who have given ratings higher than 4 to movies released before the year 2000.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(r:RATING)<-[:RATES]-(m:MOVIE) WHERE r.rating_value > 4 AND m.release_date < date('2000-01-01') RETURN avg(u.age) AS average_age

question: Find the average rating value for movies that belong to the 'Horror' genre.
gql: MATCH (m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE {name: 'Horror'}), (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(r:RATING)-[:RATES]->(m) RETURN avg(r.rating_value) AS average_rating

question: Retrieve the average rating value for movies that belong to the 'Action' genre and were produced by 'Warner Bros'.
gql: MATCH (g:GENRE {name: 'Action'})<-[:BELONGS_TO]-(m:MOVIE)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(p:PRODUCTION_COMPANY {name: 'Warner Bros'})<-[:RATES]-(r:RATING) RETURN AVG(r.rating_value) AS average_rating

question: List all movies released in the year 2000 along with their genres and the names of their directors.
gql: MATCH (m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE), (m)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d:DIRECTOR) WHERE m.release_date >= date('2000-01-01') AND m.release_date <= date('2000-12-31') RETURN m.title AS movie_title, g.name AS genre_name, d.name AS director_name

question: Retrieve the names of actors who have never directed a movie.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR) WHERE NOT EXISTS((a)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(:MOVIE)) RETURN a.name AS actor_name

question: Calculate the average age of users who have given a rating of 5 to movies released before the year 2000.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(:RATING {rating_value: 5})-[:RATES]->(m:MOVIE) WHERE m.release_date < date('2000-01-01') RETURN avg(u.age) AS AverageAge

question: Find the average rating value for movies directed by directors who have directed at least 5 movies.
gql: MATCH (d:DIRECTOR)<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(m:MOVIE)-[:RATES]->(r:RATING) RETURN d, count(m) AS movie_count NEXT FILTER movie_count >= 5 MATCH (d)<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(m:MOVIE)-[:RATES]->(r:RATING) RETURN avg(r.rating_value) AS average_rating

question: Retrieve the names of actors who have acted in at least 3 movies directed by 'Director 92', along with the count of such movies.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[ai:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d:DIRECTOR{name:'Director 92'}) RETURN a, count(m) AS movie_count NEXT FILTER movie_count >= 3 RETURN a.name, movie_count

question: What is the distribution of ratings (rating_value) given by users aged between 25 and 35, grouped by gender?
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(r:RATING) WHERE u.age >= 25 AND u.age <= 35 RETURN u.gender, r.rating_value, count(*) AS rating_distribution ORDER BY u.gender, r.rating_value

question: Find the average rating value given by users aged between 20 and 30 for movies released before the year 2000.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(r:RATING)<-[:RATES]-(m:MOVIE) WHERE u.age >= 20 AND u.age <= 30 AND m.release_date < date('2000-01-01') RETURN AVG(r.rating_value) AS average_rating

question: Retrieve all movies directed by directors who have also directed movies of the 'Action' genre.
gql: MATCH (m:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d:DIRECTOR)<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(actionMovies:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(:GENRE {name: 'Action'}) RETURN DISTINCT m.title, d.name

question: Retrieve the names of actors who have acted in at least 3 movies that belong to the 'Comedy' genre.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[ai:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE{name:'Comedy'}) RETURN a, count(m) AS comedy_movie_count NEXT FILTER comedy_movie_count >= 3 RETURN a.name

question: What is the distribution of movie genres released in the year 2000?
gql: MATCH (m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE) WHERE m.release_date >= date('2000-01-01') AND m.release_date <= date('2000-12-31') RETURN g.name AS genre, count(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC

question: Find the average rating value for movies released after January 1, 2020.
gql: MATCH (m:MOVIE)-[:RATES]->(r:RATING) WHERE m.release_date > date('2020-01-01') RETURN avg(r.rating_value) AS average_rating

question: Calculate the average age of users who have rated movies in the 'Western' genre.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(:RATING)-[:RATES]->(m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE {name: 'Western'}) RETURN AVG(u.age) AS average_age

question: Identify the production companies that have produced movies in both the 'Action' and 'Drama' genres.
gql: MATCH (p:PRODUCTION_COMPANY)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m1:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g1:GENRE {name: 'Action'}), (p)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m2:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g2:GENRE {name: 'Drama'}) RETURN DISTINCT p.name

question: List all movies that share at least two common actors with the movie titled 'Movie Title 1'.
gql: MATCH (m1:MOVIE{title:'Movie Title 1'})<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m2:MOVIE) WHERE m1 <> m2 RETURN m2, count(a) AS common_actors NEXT FILTER common_actors >= 2 RETURN DISTINCT m2.title

question: Retrieve the names of actors who have acted in movies that are similar to movies released before the year 2000, including the similarity score.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[ai:ACTED_IN]->(m1:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(m2:MOVIE) WHERE m2.release_date < date('2000-01-01') RETURN a.name, s.similarity_score

question: Which actors have acted in movies that belong to the 'Action' genre? Return distinct actor names.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE {name: 'Action'}) RETURN DISTINCT a.name

question: Identify actors who have worked in movies of the 'Action' genre and count how many such movies each actor has participated in.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE) WHERE g.name = 'Action' RETURN a, count(m) AS action_movie_count NEXT RETURN a.name, action_movie_count ORDER BY action_movie_count DESC

question: Retrieve the titles of movies released after 2000 that were directed by directors who also directed movies in the 'Action' genre.
gql: MATCH (m:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d:DIRECTOR), (d)<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(actionMovies:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE {name: 'Action'}) WHERE m.release_date > date('2000-01-01') RETURN DISTINCT m.title

question: Retrieve the average age of users who have rated movies in the 'Sci-Fi' genre, along with the total number of such ratings.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(r:RATING)-[:RATES]->(m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE {name: 'Sci-Fi'}) RETURN avg(u.age) AS average_age, count(r) AS total_ratings

question: Retrieve the names of actors who have acted in movies directed by 'Director 1' and also acted in movies belonging to the 'Action' genre.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m1:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(:DIRECTOR {name: 'Director 1'}), (a)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m2:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(:GENRE {name: 'Action'}) WHERE m1 <> m2 RETURN DISTINCT a.name

question: Retrieve the names of actors who played in movies that belong to the 'Action' genre and were released before the year 2000.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE {name: 'Action'}) WHERE m.release_date < date('2000-01-01') RETURN DISTINCT a.name

question: Identify actors who have acted in at least one movie from each of the genres 'Action' and 'Comedy'. Return the actor names and the titles of those movies.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m1:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g1:GENRE {name: 'Action'}), (a)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m2:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g2:GENRE {name: 'Comedy'}) RETURN DISTINCT a.name, m1.title, m2.title

question: List the top 5 users who have rated the most movies, along with the count of their ratings.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(r:RATING) RETURN u.USER_id AS user_id, count(r) AS rating_count ORDER BY rating_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find the production companies that have produced movies featuring actors who have acted in more than five movies. List the company names and the number of such actors associated with them.
gql: MATCH (p:PRODUCTION_COMPANY)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:MOVIE)-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:ACTOR) RETURN a, p, count(m) AS movieCount NEXT FILTER movieCount > 5 RETURN p.name AS CompanyName, count(a) AS ActorCount

question: Retrieve the average age of users who have rated movies belonging to the 'Drama' genre.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(:RATING)-[:RATES]->(m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE {name: 'Drama'}) RETURN avg(u.age) AS average_age

question: Retrieve all actors who have acted in movies directed by 'Director 92' and also find out how many such movies each actor has participated in.
gql: MATCH (d:DIRECTOR {name: 'Director 92'})<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(m:MOVIE)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:ACTOR) RETURN a.name AS actor_name, count(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC

question: Retrieve the titles of movies released after January 1, 2000, along with their genres and the names of their directors.
gql: MATCH (m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE), (m)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d:DIRECTOR) WHERE m.release_date > date('2000-01-01') RETURN m.title, g.name, d.name

question: Find the top 3 actors who have acted in the most number of movies that were released after the year 2010. Return the actor names and the count of movies.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[ai:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE) WHERE m.release_date > date('2010-01-01') RETURN a.name, COUNT(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which directors have directed movies that are similar to movies released after 2010, and what is the highest similarity score for each director?
gql: MATCH (d:DIRECTOR)<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(m1:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(m2:MOVIE) WHERE m2.release_date > date('2010-12-31') RETURN d.name, MAX(s.similarity_score) AS max_similarity

question: List the titles of movies that were produced by the same company that produced 'Movie Title 1' but exclude 'Movie Title 1' itself.
gql: MATCH (m:MOVIE {title: 'Movie Title 1'})-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(otherMovies:MOVIE) WHERE m <> otherMovies RETURN DISTINCT otherMovies.title

question: Retrieve the average rating value given by users older than 30 years for movies released after January 1, 2000.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(r:RATING)-[:RATES]->(m:MOVIE) WHERE u.age > 30 AND m.release_date > date('2000-01-01') RETURN avg(r.rating_value) AS average_rating

question: Identify actors who have acted in at least 3 movies produced by 'Silver Films', and return their names along with the count of such movies.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(p:PRODUCTION_COMPANY{name:'Silver Films'}) RETURN a, COUNT(m) AS movie_count NEXT FILTER movie_count >= 3 RETURN a.name, movie_count

question: Retrieve the titles of movies released after January 1, 2000, which have at least one actor who also acted in a movie directed by 'Director 10'.
gql: MATCH (d:DIRECTOR {name: 'Director 10'})<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(m1:MOVIE)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m2:MOVIE) WHERE m2.release_date > date('2000-01-01') RETURN DISTINCT m2.title

question: List the names of directors who have directed movies featuring actors who have played characters in more than three different movies.
gql: MATCH (d:DIRECTOR)<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(m:MOVIE)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:ACTOR) RETURN a, COUNT(DISTINCT m) AS movie_count NEXT FILTER movie_count > 3 MATCH (d)<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(m2:MOVIE)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a) RETURN DISTINCT d.name

question: Find the top 5 directors who have directed the most number of movies that belong to the 'Comedy' genre, along with the count of such movies.
gql: MATCH (d:DIRECTOR)<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE {name: 'Comedy'}) RETURN d.name, COUNT(m) AS comedy_movie_count ORDER BY comedy_movie_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: List all directors along with the number of distinct genres of movies they have directed.
gql: MATCH (d:DIRECTOR)<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE) RETURN d.name, COUNT(DISTINCT g) AS genre_count

question: Retrieve the titles of movies that were produced by 'United Pictures' and feature actors who have acted in at least 5 movies.
gql: MATCH (pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY{name:'United Pictures'})<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:MOVIE)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:ACTOR) RETURN m, a NEXT MATCH (a)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m2:MOVIE) RETURN m, COUNT(m2) AS movie_count NEXT FILTER movie_count >= 5 RETURN DISTINCT m.title

question: Find the top 3 genres with the highest average similarity scores among their movies.
gql: MATCH (g:GENRE)<-[:BELONGS_TO]-(m1:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(m2:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g) RETURN g.name, AVG(s.similarity_score) AS avg_similarity ORDER BY avg_similarity DESC LIMIT 3

question: Find the production companies that have produced movies featuring 'Actor 1' and calculate the total number of such distinct actors per company.
gql: MATCH (pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:MOVIE)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:ACTOR) WHERE a.name = 'Actor 1' RETURN pc, m NEXT MATCH (m)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(other_actors:ACTOR) RETURN pc.name, count(DISTINCT other_actors) AS distinct_actor_count

question: Show the name of actors who have never worked in a movie of the 'Comedy' genre.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR) WHERE NOT EXISTS((a)-[:ACTED_IN]->(:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(:GENRE {name: 'Comedy'})) RETURN a.name

question: Count how many movies each production company has produced that feature actors who have played more than one character in the same movie.
gql: MATCH (pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:MOVIE)<-[ai:ACTED_IN]-(a:ACTOR) RETURN pc, m, COUNT(ai.character_name) AS characters_per_actor NEXT FILTER characters_per_actor > 1 RETURN pc.name, COUNT(DISTINCT m) AS movie_count

question: Identify users who have rated more than 10 movies and find the total number of movies each of these users has rated.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(r:RATING) RETURN u, count(r) AS rated_movies NEXT FILTER rated_movies > 10 RETURN u.USER_id, rated_movies

question: Find the production companies that have produced movies featuring 'Actor 50' and calculate the total number of such movies per company.
gql: MATCH (pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:MOVIE)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:ACTOR {name: 'Actor 50'}) RETURN pc.name, COUNT(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC

question: Retrieve the top 5 directors whose movies have the highest average similarity scores with other movies, including the director's name and the computed average similarity score.
gql: MATCH (d:DIRECTOR)<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(m:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]-(m2:MOVIE) RETURN d.name AS Director, AVG(s.similarity_score) AS AvgSimilarityScore ORDER BY AvgSimilarityScore DESC LIMIT 5

question: Return the top 10 most active users based on the number of ratings they've given, including only those users who have also assigned at least one tag.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(r:RATING) RETURN u, COUNT(r) AS rating_count NEXT MATCH (u)-[:ASSIGNS]->(t:TAG) RETURN u, rating_count, COUNT(t) AS tag_count NEXT FILTER tag_count >= 1 RETURN u.USER_id, rating_count ORDER BY rating_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: Identify actors who have worked in movies directed by directors who have directed at least three movies. Return the actor names and the number of such movies they've acted in.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d:DIRECTOR) RETURN d, COUNT(m) AS directed_movies NEXT FILTER directed_movies >= 3 MATCH (a2:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m2:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d) RETURN a2.name AS ActorName, COUNT(m2) AS MovieCount

question: List the titles of movies that were produced by 'United Pictures' and belong to the 'Drama' genre, sorted by release date in descending order.
gql: MATCH (m:MOVIE)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY {name: 'United Pictures'}), (m)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE {name: 'Drama'}) RETURN m.title ORDER BY m.release_date DESC

question: What are the titles of movies that were produced by 'United Pictures' and belong to the 'Sci-Fi' genre?
gql: MATCH (m:MOVIE)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY {name: 'United Pictures'}), (m)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE {name: 'Sci-Fi'}) RETURN m.title

question: List the names of actors who have acted in at least 3 movies directed by 'Director 48', along with the count of such movies.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d:DIRECTOR{name:'Director 48'}) RETURN a, COUNT(m) AS movie_count NEXT FILTER movie_count >= 3 RETURN a.name, movie_count

question: Retrieve the names of actors who have acted in movies that are similar to movies directed by 'Director 50', ensuring the similarity score is above 0.5.
gql: MATCH (d:DIRECTOR {name: 'Director 50'})<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(m1:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(m2:MOVIE)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:ACTOR) WHERE s.similarity_score > 0.5 RETURN DISTINCT a.name

question: List all actors who have acted in movies directed by 'Director 40', including the character names they portrayed in those movies.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[ai:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(:DIRECTOR {name: 'Director 40'}) RETURN a.name, ai.character_name

question: Find the number of unique users who have assigned tags to movies released in the year 2010.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:ASSIGNS]->(t:TAG)<-[:ASSIGNS]-(m:MOVIE) WHERE m.release_date >= date('2010-01-01') AND m.release_date < date('2011-01-01') RETURN count(DISTINCT u) AS unique_users

question: Determine the number of unique users who have both rated and tagged the same movie.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(:RATING)-[:RATES]->(m:MOVIE), (u)-[:ASSIGNS]->(:TAG)-[:ASSIGNS]->(m) RETURN count(DISTINCT u) AS user_count

question: Find the top 5 actors who have appeared in the most genres of movies and list the genres along with the count of movies per genre for each actor.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE) RETURN a, g, COUNT(m) AS movie_count_per_genre NEXT RETURN a.name AS actor_name, g.name AS genre, movie_count_per_genre ORDER BY actor_name, movie_count_per_genre DESC

question: Retrieve the average age of users who have rated movies released after January 1, 2000, and tagged them with the word 'awesome'.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(:RATING)-[:RATES]->(m:MOVIE), (u)-[:ASSIGNS]->(:TAG {tag_text: 'awesome'}) WHERE m.release_date > date('2000-01-01') RETURN avg(u.age) AS average_age

question: List the titles of movies that were directed by directors who have directed at least 3 movies in the database, excluding movies from the 'Comedy' genre.
gql: MATCH (d:DIRECTOR)<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(m:MOVIE) RETURN d, COUNT(m) AS movie_count NEXT FILTER movie_count >= 3 MATCH (d)<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(non_comedy_movies:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE) WHERE g.name <> 'Comedy' RETURN DISTINCT non_comedy_movies.title

question: Retrieve the names of directors who have directed movies that are similar to at least one movie released after the year 2010, with a similarity score greater than 0.7.
gql: MATCH (d:DIRECTOR)<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(m1:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(m2:MOVIE) WHERE m2.release_date > date('2010-12-31') AND s.similarity_score > 0.7 RETURN DISTINCT d.name AS director_name

question: Which actors have worked with directors who have directed more than 3 movies? Provide the actor names and the director names, ensuring no duplicates.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d:DIRECTOR) RETURN d, count(m) AS movie_directed_count NEXT FILTER movie_directed_count > 3 MATCH (a)-[:ACTED_IN]->(:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d) RETURN DISTINCT a.name, d.name

question: Find the average rating value for movies that belong to the 'Sci-Fi' genre and were produced by 'United Pictures'.
gql: MATCH (m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(:GENRE {name: 'Sci-Fi'}), (m)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(:PRODUCTION_COMPANY {name: 'United Pictures'}), (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(r:RATING)-[:RATES]->(m) RETURN avg(r.rating_value) AS average_rating

question: Identify the actors who have acted in movies that are similar to at least two other movies with a similarity score higher than 0.5.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(sm:MOVIE) WHERE s.similarity_score > 0.5 RETURN a, COUNT(sm) AS similar_movie_count NEXT FILTER similar_movie_count >= 2 RETURN a.name, similar_movie_count

question: Identify the top 3 users who have given the highest total rating values across all movies they rated, and return their IDs along with the sum of their ratings.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[r:RATES]->(rat:RATING) RETURN u.USER_id, SUM(rat.rating_value) AS total_rating ORDER BY total_rating DESC LIMIT 3

question: Retrieve the names of actors who have acted in at least two movies that are similar to each other with a similarity score greater than 0.7.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m1:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]-(m2:MOVIE)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a) WHERE s.similarity_score > 0.7 RETURN DISTINCT a.name

question: Find the average age of users who have rated movies directed by 'Director 45' with a rating value less than 3.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(r:RATING)<-[:RATES]-(m:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d:DIRECTOR {name: 'Director 45'}) WHERE r.rating_value < 3 RETURN AVG(u.age) AS average_age

question: For each director, find the total number of movies they have directed and the average similarity score of their movies compared to other movies. Only include directors whose movies have an average similarity score greater than 0.5.
gql: MATCH (d:DIRECTOR)<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(m1:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(m2:MOVIE) RETURN d, COUNT(m1) AS total_movies, AVG(s.similarity_score) AS avg_similarity NEXT FILTER avg_similarity > 0.5 RETURN d.name AS director_name, total_movies, avg_similarity

question: List the names of actors who have never acted in any movie belonging to the 'Romance' genre.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR) WHERE NOT EXISTS((a)-[:ACTED_IN]->(:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(:GENRE {name: 'Romance'})) RETURN a.name

question: Identify the average age of users who tagged movies belonging to the 'Comedy' genre.
gql: MATCH (u:USER {age: 25})-[:ASSIGNS]->(t:TAG)-[:ASSIGNS]->(m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE {name: 'Comedy'}) RETURN avg(u.age) AS average_age

question: Find pairs of movies that share at least two common actors and calculate the average similarity score between them if they are connected via the SIMILAR_TO relationship. Return the movie titles and their average similarity score.
gql: MATCH (m1:MOVIE)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m2:MOVIE) WHERE m1 < m2 RETURN m1, m2, count(a) AS common_actors NEXT FILTER common_actors >= 2 MATCH (m1)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(m2) RETURN m1.title, m2.title, avg(s.similarity_score) AS avg_similarity

question: Find the top 5 actors who have acted in the most movies that belong to the 'Drama' genre, along with the count of such movies.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[ai:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE{name:'Drama'}) RETURN a, COUNT(m) AS drama_movie_count NEXT RETURN a.name AS actor, drama_movie_count ORDER BY drama_movie_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Retrieve the names of directors who have directed movies featuring 'Actor 119', along with the number of such collaborations.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR {name: 'Actor 119'})-[ai:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d:DIRECTOR) RETURN d.name, count(m) AS collaboration_count

question: List all movies released in the year 2000 that were directed by directors who have also directed movies in the 'Thriller' genre. Include the movie titles and director names.
gql: MATCH (m:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d:DIRECTOR), (d)<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE {name: 'Thriller'}) WHERE m.release_date >= date('2000-01-01') AND m.release_date <= date('2000-12-31') RETURN DISTINCT m.title, d.name

question: Find the average age of users who have tagged movies with the tag 'funny' and have also rated those movies with a rating value greater than 3.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:ASSIGNS]->(t:TAG {tag_text: 'funny'})<-[:ASSIGNS]-(u), (u)-[:RATES]->(r:RATING)-[:RATES]->(m:MOVIE) WHERE r.rating_value > 3 RETURN AVG(u.age) AS average_age

question: List the top 10 production companies based on the total number of movies they have produced, including only those movies that belong to the 'Comedy' genre.
gql: MATCH (pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE {name: 'Comedy'}) RETURN pc.name AS production_company, COUNT(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: For each actor, find the number of distinct genres of movies they have acted in, and return only those actors who have acted in more than 5 distinct genres, sorted by the number of genres in descending order.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE) RETURN a, COUNT(DISTINCT g) AS genre_count NEXT FILTER genre_count > 5 RETURN a.name, genre_count ORDER BY genre_count DESC

question: Find the top 10 users who have rated movies with an average rating value greater than 4, along with their average rating.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(r:RATING) RETURN u, avg(r.rating_value) AS avg_rating NEXT FILTER avg_rating > 4 RETURN u.USER_id, avg_rating ORDER BY avg_rating DESC LIMIT 10

question: Retrieve the titles of movies released after January 1, 2000, which belong to the 'Sci-Fi' genre and were produced by 'Global Studios', along with their release dates.
gql: MATCH (m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE {name: 'Sci-Fi'}), (m)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY {name: 'Global Studios'}) WHERE m.release_date > date('2000-01-01') RETURN m.title, m.release_date

question: Find all production companies that have produced movies directed by 'Director 92', and list the total number of movies each company produced under this director's guidance.
gql: MATCH (pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d:DIRECTOR {name: 'Director 92'}) RETURN pc.name AS production_company, count(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC

question: List the names of actors who have never acted in any movie tagged with the word 'horror'.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR) WHERE NOT EXISTS ((a)-[:ACTED_IN]->(:MOVIE)<-[:ASSIGNS]-(:TAG {tag_text: 'horror'})) RETURN a.name AS actor_name

question: List all movies that share at least one actor with 'Movie Title 1' but exclude 'Movie Title 1' itself, along with the shared actor names.
gql: MATCH (m1:MOVIE {title: 'Movie Title 1'})<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m2:MOVIE) WHERE m1 <> m2 RETURN DISTINCT m2.title AS related_movie, a.name AS shared_actor

question: Find the average similarity score for movies that belong to the 'Drama' genre and have been rated by users older than 40.
gql: MATCH (g:GENRE {name: 'Drama'})<-[:BELONGS_TO]-(m:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(:MOVIE), (m)<-[:RATES]-(:RATING)<-[:RATES]-(u:USER) WHERE u.age > 40 RETURN AVG(s.similarity_score) AS avg_similarity_score

question: List all genres that have at least one movie released in the last 5 years and compute the average similarity score of movies within each of these genres.
gql: MATCH (g:GENRE)<-[:BELONGS_TO]-(m1:MOVIE), (m1)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(m2:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g) WHERE m1.release_date >= date('2019-01-01') RETURN g.name AS genre, AVG(s.similarity_score) AS avg_similarity_score

question: Find the titles of movies that have been acted in by actors who have played more than 3 different characters across all movies.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[ai:ACTED_IN]->(:MOVIE) RETURN a, count(DISTINCT ai.character_name) AS character_count NEXT FILTER character_count > 3 MATCH (a)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE) RETURN DISTINCT m.title

question: Find the production companies that have produced movies featuring actors who have acted in at least 10 movies, and return the company names along with the count of such movies.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE) RETURN a, COUNT(m) AS movie_count NEXT FILTER movie_count >= 10 MATCH (a)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY) RETURN pc.name AS production_company, COUNT(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC

question: Identify the top 3 genres with the highest number of distinct actors who have acted in movies of that genre, and return the genre name and actor count.
gql: MATCH (g:GENRE)<-[:BELONGS_TO]-(m:MOVIE)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:ACTOR) RETURN g.name AS genre_name, COUNT(DISTINCT a) AS actor_count ORDER BY actor_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: Find actors who have acted in movies that are similar to at least two other movies (based on the SIMILAR_TO relationship) and list the actor names along with the count of such similar movie connections.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m1:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(m2:MOVIE) RETURN a, COUNT(s) AS similar_connections NEXT FILTER similar_connections >= 2 RETURN a.name AS actor_name, similar_connections

question: Identify actors who have acted in movies directed by directors with whom they share the same gender, assuming gender data is available for both actors and directors.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d:DIRECTOR) WHERE a.gender = d.gender RETURN DISTINCT a.name

question: Determine the average age of users who have rated movies produced by 'Warner Bros.' with a rating value less than 3.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(r:RATING)<-[:RATES]-(m:MOVIE)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY {name: 'Warner Bros.'}) WHERE r.rating_value < 3 RETURN AVG(u.age) AS average_age

question: Find actors who have acted in movies directed by directors who have directed at least 10 movies. Return the actor names and the number of such movies they've acted in.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d:DIRECTOR) RETURN d, COUNT(m) AS movie_count NEXT FILTER movie_count >= 10 MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d) RETURN a.name, COUNT(m) AS acted_in_directors_movies

question: List all genres along with the number of distinct directors who have directed movies in each genre, sorted by the number of directors in descending order.
gql: MATCH (g:GENRE)<-[:BELONGS_TO]-(m:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d:DIRECTOR) RETURN g.name, COUNT(DISTINCT d) AS director_count ORDER BY director_count DESC

question: Find users who have rated at least 5 movies and return their IDs, ages, and the average rating they gave.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(r:RATING) RETURN u, COUNT(r) AS rating_count, AVG(r.rating_value) AS avg_rating NEXT FILTER rating_count >= 5 RETURN u.USER_id, u.age, avg_rating

question: List all genres along with the number of distinct directors who have directed movies in each genre.
gql: MATCH (g:GENRE)<-[:BELONGS_TO]-(m:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d:DIRECTOR) RETURN g.name AS Genre, COUNT(DISTINCT d) AS NumberOfDirectors

question: List all genres that have at least one movie released after 2015 and include the count of such movies per genre.
gql: MATCH (g:GENRE)<-[:BELONGS_TO]-(m:MOVIE) WHERE m.release_date > date('2015-12-31') RETURN g.name AS Genre, COUNT(m) AS MovieCount

question: What are the average ratings given by users aged between 25 and 35 for movies released in the year 2020?
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(r:RATING)-[:RATES]->(m:MOVIE) WHERE u.age >= 25 AND u.age <= 35 AND m.release_date >= date('2020-01-01') AND m.release_date <= date('2020-12-31') RETURN avg(r.rating_value) AS average_rating

question: Find the top 5 actors who have acted in the most number of movies that belong to the 'Comedy' genre, and return their names along with the count of such movies.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[ai:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE {name: 'Comedy'}) RETURN a.name, COUNT(m) AS comedy_movie_count ORDER BY comedy_movie_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: Find the average similarity score between movies directed by 'Director 5' and movies directed by 'Director 15'.
gql: MATCH (d1:DIRECTOR {name: 'Director 5'})<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(m1:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(m2:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d2:DIRECTOR {name: 'Director 15'}) RETURN AVG(s.similarity_score) AS average_similarity_score

question: Find the most frequently used tag text assigned by users aged between 20 and 30, and return the tag text along with its usage count.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:ASSIGNS]->(t:TAG) WHERE u.age >= 20 AND u.age <= 30 RETURN t.tag_text, count(*) AS usage_count ORDER BY usage_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: Return the names of actors who have acted in movies across the maximum number of different production companies. Also, provide the count of those distinct production companies.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY) RETURN a, COUNT(DISTINCT pc) AS distinct_companies NEXT RETURN a.name, distinct_companies ORDER BY distinct_companies DESC LIMIT 1

question: Find production companies that have produced movies featuring actors who have acted in movies directed by 'Director 42', and return the company names along with the count of such distinct actors.
gql: MATCH (pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:MOVIE)-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m2:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d:DIRECTOR {name: 'Director 42'}) RETURN pc.name, count(DISTINCT a) AS actor_count

question: Which directors have directed movies that are similar to at least one movie with a similarity score greater than 0.8? Provide the director's name and the highest similarity score among their movies.
gql: MATCH (d:DIRECTOR)<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(m:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(similar:MOVIE) WHERE s.similarity_score > 0.8 RETURN d, MAX(s.similarity_score) AS max_similarity NEXT RETURN d.name AS director_name, max_similarity ORDER BY max_similarity DESC

question: Find the production companies that have produced movies featuring actors who have acted in movies of more than 3 different genres. Return the company names and the count of distinct genres.
gql: MATCH (pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:MOVIE)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:ACTOR) RETURN pc, a NEXT MATCH (a)-[:ACTED_IN]->(:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE) RETURN pc, COUNT(DISTINCT g) AS genre_count NEXT FILTER genre_count > 3 RETURN pc.name, genre_count

question: Which actors have acted in movies that are similar to at least 5 other movies, and what is the total similarity score for each of these actors' movies? Return the actor's name and the total similarity score.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(:MOVIE) RETURN a, SUM(s.similarity_score) AS total_similarity, COUNT(s) AS similar_movies NEXT FILTER similar_movies >= 5 RETURN a.name, total_similarity

question: List all movies that belong to the 'Action' genre and were produced by 'United Pictures', along with their release dates and IMDb URLs.
gql: MATCH (m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE {name: 'Action'}), (m)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY {name: 'United Pictures'}) RETURN m.title, m.release_date, m.imdb_url

question: Retrieve the names of actors who have acted in movies that are similar to movies directed by 'Director 10', with a similarity score greater than 0.8.

question: Find pairs of production companies that have produced movies with at least one common actor, and return the company names along with the count of such shared actors.
gql: MATCH (pc1:PRODUCTION_COMPANY)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m1:MOVIE)<-[ai1:ACTED_IN]-(a:ACTOR)-[ai2:ACTED_IN]->(m2:MOVIE)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc2:PRODUCTION_COMPANY) WHERE pc1 < pc2 RETURN pc1, pc2, COUNT(DISTINCT a) AS shared_actors NEXT RETURN pc1.name, pc2.name, shared_actors ORDER BY shared_actors DESC

question: Which actors have acted in movies across the most number of distinct production companies? Return the actor's name and the count of distinct production companies they've worked with, limited to the top 3 actors.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY) RETURN a, COUNT(DISTINCT pc) AS company_count NEXT RETURN a.name, company_count ORDER BY company_count DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which actors have never appeared in a movie directed by 'Director A'? Provide their names.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR) WHERE NOT EXISTS ((a)-[:ACTED_IN]->(:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(:DIRECTOR {name: 'Director A'})) RETURN a.name

question: Identify directors who have directed movies featuring actors that have acted in at least 10 movies. Return the director's name and the number of such prolific actors they've worked with.
gql: MATCH (d:DIRECTOR)<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(m:MOVIE)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:ACTOR) RETURN a, count(m) AS movie_count NEXT FILTER movie_count >= 10 MATCH (d:DIRECTOR)<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(m:MOVIE)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a) RETURN d.name, count(DISTINCT a) AS prolific_actor_count

question: List the names of actors who have acted in movies directed by 'Director 92' and also acted in movies produced by 'Big Media'. Ensure no duplicates in the result.

question: Identify the top 5 actors who have appeared in the most movies that belong to the 'Sci-Fi' genre, returning their names and the count of such movies.

question: Calculate the average age of users who have rated movies with a similarity score greater than 0.8 with at least one other movie.

question: Which production companies have produced movies that are similar to at least one movie released before the year 2000? Return the company names and the count of such movies.

question: Retrieve the names of actors who have acted in movies produced by 'Big Media' and have also acted in movies directed by 'Director 10', ensuring no duplicates in the result.
gql: MATCH (pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY {name: 'Big Media'})<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m1:MOVIE)-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m2:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d:DIRECTOR {name: 'Director 10'}) RETURN DISTINCT a.name

question: List the top 5 genres by the number of movies released in the year 2000, including the genre name and the count of movies.

question: Identify actors who have worked in movies produced by both 'United Pictures' and 'Global Studios'. Return the actor names and the count of distinct movies they have acted in from each production company.

question: Retrieve the names of actors who have acted in movies produced by 'Big Media' and also directed by 'Director 92'. Ensure no duplicate actor names in the result.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY {name: 'Big Media'}), (m)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d:DIRECTOR {name: 'Director 92'}) RETURN DISTINCT a.name AS actor_name

question: Find the top 5 directors who have worked with the highest number of distinct actors and return their names along with the count of distinct actors.

question: Identify the production companies that have produced movies released in the year 2000 and also find the total number of such movies per company.
gql: MATCH (pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:MOVIE) WHERE m.release_date >= date('2000-01-01') AND m.release_date <= date('2000-12-31') RETURN pc.name, COUNT(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC

question: Find the top 5 actors who have acted in the highest number of movies that belong to the 'Thriller' genre and were released before the year 2000. Return the actor names and the count of such movies.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE {name: 'Thriller'}) WHERE m.release_date < date('2000-01-01') RETURN a.name AS actor_name, count(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: List all genres along with the average similarity score of movies within each genre compared to movies in the 'Action' genre. Only include genres where this average score is greater than 0.6.

question: Identify actors who have acted in movies directed by 'Director 92' and also appeared in at least one movie produced by 'Golden Pictures'. Return the actor names and the count of distinct genres they've worked in.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m1:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d:DIRECTOR{name:'Director 92'}), (a)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m2:MOVIE)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY{name:'Golden Pictures'}) RETURN a NEXT MATCH (a)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE) RETURN a.name, COUNT(DISTINCT g) AS genre_count

question: Retrieve the names of actors who have acted in movies that are similar to movies directed by 'Director 25', ensuring that the similarity score is greater than 0.8. Return each actor's name along with the count of such distinct movies.

question: Identify the production companies that have produced movies directed by 'Director 15' and also produced movies in the 'Horror' genre. Return the company names and the count of such distinct movies.

question: Retrieve the titles of movies that were produced by 'Global Pictures' and feature at least one actor who has also acted in a movie released before the year 2000.

question: List all production companies that have produced movies featuring actors who have acted in movies with a similarity score greater than 0.9.

question: Retrieve the titles of movies released after January 1, 2000, that are similar to each other with a similarity score greater than 0.8, and list them alongside their release dates.

question: List all genres that have at least one movie with a similarity score greater than 0.8 to another movie released before the year 1990.
gql: MATCH (g:GENRE)<-[:BELONGS_TO]-(m1:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(m2:MOVIE) WHERE s.similarity_score > 0.8 AND m2.release_date < date('1990-01-01') RETURN DISTINCT g.name

question: Find users who have rated movies with a rating value of 5 and have also assigned tags to movies, returning their user IDs and the total number of ratings and tags they have given.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(r:RATING{rating_value:5}) RETURN u, COUNT(r) AS high_ratings NEXT MATCH (u)-[:ASSIGNS]->(t:TAG) RETURN u.USER_id, high_ratings, COUNT(t) AS total_tags

question: List the titles of movies which are similar to movies released before the year 2000 with a similarity score greater than 0.9, but were themselves released after the year 2010.

question: Retrieve the names of actors who have acted in at least two different movies directed by the same director and return the actor's name along with the director's name and the count of such collaborations.

question: List directors who have directed movies that are similar to at least 5 other movies with a similarity score above 0.8. Include the director's name and the count of such high-similarity connections.
gql: MATCH (d:DIRECTOR)<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(m:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(m2:MOVIE) WHERE s.similarity_score > 0.8 RETURN d, COUNT(s) AS high_similarity_count NEXT FILTER high_similarity_count >= 5 RETURN d.name, high_similarity_count

question: Find actors who have acted in movies that are similar to movies directed by 'Director 15' with a similarity score greater than 0.7, and return the actor names along with the count of such distinct movies.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m1:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(m2:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d:DIRECTOR {name: 'Director 15'}) WHERE s.similarity_score > 0.7 RETURN a.name, COUNT(DISTINCT m1) AS distinct_movies

question: Find the average age of users who have given ratings higher than 4 to movies that are similar to movies directed by 'Director 2' with a similarity score greater than 0.7.

question: List the names of actors who have acted in movies directed by directors who have directed at least 3 movies, and return the actor names along with the number of such movies they've acted in.
gql: MATCH (d:DIRECTOR)<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(m:MOVIE) RETURN d, COUNT(m) AS movie_count NEXT FILTER movie_count >= 3 MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(d) RETURN a.name, COUNT(m) AS num_movies

question: List the names of actors who have acted in at least three movies that share the same genre, and return the actor names along with the genre name and the count of such movies.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE) RETURN a, g, COUNT(m) AS movie_count NEXT FILTER movie_count >= 3 RETURN a.name, g.name, movie_count

question: What are the names of directors who have directed movies with a similarity score greater than 0.8 to any other movie, and what is the highest similarity score among those connections?
gql: MATCH (d:DIRECTOR)<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(m1:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(m2:MOVIE) WHERE s.similarity_score > 0.8 RETURN d.name, MAX(s.similarity_score) AS max_similarity

question: Calculate the average age of users who have assigned tags to movies belonging to the 'Sci-Fi' genre. Only include users whose age is recorded.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:ASSIGNS]->(:TAG)-[:ASSIGNS]->(m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE {name: 'Sci-Fi'}) WHERE u.age IS NOT NULL RETURN AVG(u.age) AS average_age

question: Find movies that have been acted in by at least 10 actors and belong to more than two genres. Return the movie title and the number of actors and genres associated with it.

question: Find users who have given a rating of 5 to more than two movies and also have assigned tags to at least one movie. Return their user IDs and the count of distinct movies they've tagged.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:RATES]->(r:RATING) WHERE r.rating_value = 5 RETURN u, COUNT(r) AS five_star_ratings NEXT FILTER five_star_ratings > 2 MATCH (u)-[:ASSIGNS]->(t:TAG) RETURN u, COUNT(DISTINCT t.TAG_id) AS tagged_movies NEXT FILTER tagged_movies >= 1 RETURN u.USER_id, tagged_movies

question: Find the top 10 actors who have acted in the most movies that belong to the 'Action' genre, and return their names along with the count of such movies.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[ai:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE {name: 'Action'}) RETURN a.name, COUNT(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: Identify the genres that have the highest number of movies produced by 'Global Studios', and return the genre names along with the count of movies.
gql: MATCH (pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY {name: 'Global Studios'})<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:MOVIE)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(g:GENRE) RETURN g.name, COUNT(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC

question: Find the production companies that have produced movies released in the year 2000 and return the company names along with the count of such movies.
gql: MATCH (pc:PRODUCTION_COMPANY)<-[:PRODUCED_BY]-(m:MOVIE) WHERE m.release_date >= date('2000-01-01') AND m.release_date <= date('2000-12-31') RETURN pc.name, COUNT(m) AS movie_count

question: Retrieve the names of directors who have directed movies that are similar to at least two other movies with a similarity score greater than 0.8. Include the director's name and the count of such high-similarity connections.
gql: MATCH (d:DIRECTOR)<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(m1:MOVIE)-[s:SIMILAR_TO]->(m2:MOVIE) WHERE s.similarity_score > 0.8 RETURN d, COUNT(s) AS high_similarity_count NEXT FILTER high_similarity_count >= 2 RETURN d.name, high_similarity_count

question: Retrieve the titles of movies that were produced by 'Global Studios' and belong to the 'Action' genre, along with their release dates.
gql: MATCH (m:MOVIE)-[:PRODUCED_BY]->(:PRODUCTION_COMPANY {name: 'Global Studios'}), (m)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(:GENRE {name: 'Action'}) RETURN m.title, m.release_date

question: Identify actors who have acted in at least 3 movies directed by 'Director 10', and return their names along with the count of such movies.
gql: MATCH (a:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)-[:DIRECTED_BY]->(:DIRECTOR {name: 'Director 10'}) RETURN a.name, COUNT(m) AS movie_count ORDER BY movie_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: Find pairs of actors who have acted in at least three movies together, and return their names along with the count of movies they've co-starred in.
gql: MATCH (a1:ACTOR)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:MOVIE)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a2:ACTOR) WHERE a1.ACTOR_id < a2 RETURN a1, a2, COUNT(m) AS movies_together NEXT FILTER movies_together >= 3 RETURN a1.name, a2.name, movies_together

question: Find the top 10 users who have assigned the most tags to movies, along with the total number of tags they've assigned and their occupation.
gql: MATCH (u:USER)-[:ASSIGNS]->(t:TAG) RETURN u.USER_id, u.occupation, COUNT(t) AS tag_count ORDER BY tag_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: List the names of directors who have directed movies in which actors born before 1980 have played roles, along with the average age of those actors.
gql: MATCH (d:DIRECTOR)<-[:DIRECTED_BY]-(m:MOVIE)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(a:ACTOR) WHERE a.born < date('1980-01-01') RETURN d.name, AVG(a.age) AS average_actor_age

question: Identify the top 10 actors who have acted in the highest number of movies produced by 'Global Studios', including the count of movies.

question: Identify actors who have acted in at least 3 movies directed by the same director and list the director's name along with the actor's name.

question: Retrieve the top 5 most frequently used tags across all movies, along with the count of how many times each tag was used.

question: Identify actors who have acted in movies across more than 3 different genres and have also worked with at least two different directors. Return the actor's name, count of distinct genres, and count of distinct directors.
